features.name: decide / gate — pure decision core
features.what_it_does: Offline, deterministic, fail-closed gate. `decide <signals-json>` (arg or stdin) maps {actor_mode,current_phase,requested_phase,completed_phases,phase_gate} to {action,missing_prereq,reason}. Skip-detection requires every prior phase complete (agent->refuse, human->warn). Per gate_type: verdict (APPROVED->allow / NEEDS_REVIEW->warn / BLOCKED->block), runner (exit 0->allow, 1 or 2(EMPTY)->block), coverage (OK->allow / MISSING->block), artifact (present true/false). Any malformed/unknown input -> refuse. `decide` ALWAYS exits 0; `gate` re-maps allow->0, warn->3, refuse->1 for loop callers.
